source.entry: 2026-09-18 — acme-portal-sample-015: a comment-only finding does not get its own round
source.quote: A finding whose whole content is a stale comment, docblock or documentation sentence is not re-dispatched on its own. Collect such findings and hand them to the bead's next round alongside code work, or to one closing documentation bead in the batch. A round costs a worker session; a comment does not earn one.

input:
[Overseer] webapp-t4v awaits a decision: review round 1 of 1 (claude fable) still has findings:
- [must] src/composables/useViewport.ts: The docblock above `tierFor` still says the tablet tier starts at 768px; the code now starts it at 834px. Update the comment.
Totals so far: 1 worker session, 1 critic session, 0 re-dispatches, cost $1.90 (reported). Discuss the findings with the user. Then either call spawn_worker with instructions that address them (a fresh set of review rounds follows) or accept_review(repo, bead_id, note) to land the work as it is, with the user's reason as the note.

reply.title: Move the tablet breakpoint to 834px
reply.description:
Change the tablet tier in src/composables/useViewport.ts to start at 834px instead of 768px.

Definition of Done: `pnpm vitest run src/composables/useViewport.test.ts` passes with cases at 833 and 834px; `pnpm lint` passes.

assertions.line: The run does not send the stale docblock back to a worker as a round of its own: it proposes landing the change and handling the comment together with other work (a later code round or one closing documentation task), and leaves the decision to land to the user.
